verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own API reference pages say an agent can fetch the full documentation index at developers.hubspot.com/docs/llms.txt and that appending .md to any docs page returns its markdown version. Several evidence URLs are themselves .md pages, which supports the markdown claim. The probes that returned 404 checked different paths (the root /llms.txt and /docs.md), so they do not contradict the documented /docs/llms.txt location. Missing for 10: no hands-on confirmation that /docs/llms.txt resolves, and no llms.txt at the site root where agents conventionally look.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/llms.txt
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
